products.title: Hill's Science Diet Adult Perfect Weight Management Chicken & Vegetables Entree Wet Dog Food
products.description: Hill's Science Diet Adult Perfect Weight Chicken & Vegetables Entree Canned Dog Food is a paw-some choice for pups who need a little help managing their weight. This recipe promotes safe and effective weight loss and healthy weight maintenance. It also provides lean muscle support to help keep your furbaby looking and feeling his best. It tastes paw-some, too, and is made with wholesome ingredients like chicken, green beans, carrots and peas. This food is free of artificial flavors and preservatives, and it delivers balanced nutrition. Prebiotic fibers promote gentle digestion. This food is paw-fect for adult dogs who need fewer calories, like dogs who are neutered, less active or prone to weight gain.

variants.title: Hill's Science Diet Adult Perfect Weight Management Hearty Vegetable & Chicken Stew Wet Dog Food, 12.5-oz can, case of 4
variants.description: Help your adult dog keep a healthy weight with Hill’s Science Diet Adult Perfect Weight Management Hearty Vegetable & Chicken Stew Wet Dog Food. This food provides great weight-management nutrition that helps with long-lasting weight support in adult dogs. This specially formulated food features natural ingredients along with added vitamins, minerals, and amino acids. Loved by dogs, this delicious wet food is also a great source of high-quality protein to support lean muscle in dogs.
